title: Did Dune Predict the AI War? (The Sandworm Movie Saw It Coming) #dune
description:
Did you know Dune basically predicted the AI war against humanity? In the story, there are no computers because humanity fought a nearly century-long war against thinking machines and banned them for about ten thousand years. Humans became the computers instead: the Mentats.

Dune: Part Three is due December 18, 2026.
